Gopal's M.Sc. project on renormalization in quantum electrodynamics.
QED: the quantum field theory of electrons, positrons and photons.
Pictorial rules for computing scattering amplitudes in QED.
Photon-electron scattering; its lab-frame cross section is Klein-Nishina.
Electron-positron scattering with t- and s-channel photon exchange.
Electron-electron scattering with t- and u-channel exchange.
e+ e- -> mu+ mu- through an s-channel photon.
Gauge-invariance identity implying Z1 = Z2 in QED.
Regularizes loop integrals in n = 4 - eps dimensions; poles appear as 2/eps.
One-loop photon self-energy; its pole fixes Z3 and the running of alpha.
One-loop correction to the electron propagator giving Z2 and the mass shift.
Running of the coupling with scale; QED one loop: beta(e) = e^3/(12 pi^2).
Coupling that changes with energy scale, e.g. 1/alpha from 137 to ~129 at M_Z.
QCD coupling weakens at high energy while beta0 = 11 - 2nf/3 > 0.
Open-source repo turning the M.Sc. renormalization work into SymPy code plus AI experiments.
Python package in qft-renorm-ai that derives QED counterterms symbolically.
STLSQ (SINDy-style) regression selecting few terms from a library.

Benchmark of an LLM alone vs an LLM calling computer-algebra tools on 24 loop tasks.
Open-source graph RAG: LightRAG build, NetworkX/Neo4j storage, path-walking retrievers.
Bidirectional search: forward from anchors, backward from answer candidates, joined at a midpoint.
Ranks the anchors' hub-guarded reachable set to propose answer nodes.
Never traverses nodes with degree above a threshold, removing generic distractor paths.
Scores query-candidate pairs jointly with a local transformer.
Document-routed, question-filtered beam walk for long regulatory corpora.
Answers single-pass and decomposes the question only on abstention.
Self-ask: resolve the bridge entity, then re-query with it named.
Questions whose answer is several relations away from what they mention.
Public multi-hop QA benchmark; Gopal's graph has 52,474 nodes over 10,000 documents.
Meet-in-the-middle with reranked answer seeding raised clean-70 accuracy from 47% to 53%.
Single-first router: 70.2% -> 76.9% on 952 questions, decomposing only 18%.
Gold-path recall 100% vs 88.6% for enumeration with about 200x fewer candidate paths.
Layered graph over 371 financial-regulation documents (17,326 pages).
46,508 entities and 109,572 relations for $35.1, about $2.03 per 1,000 pages.
Open-source graph RAG library used for entity and relation extraction.
Graph database; Gopal's adapter reproduced 25/25 query results and loads the graph in 7 s.
Python graph library used for research-time graph walks.
Open-weight LLM family Gopal serves with vLLM for on-premises graph building.

Recovers heading levels from typography and keeps tables intact before chunking.
YOLOv8 layout detector trained on DocLayNet.
Dense embeddings plus BM25 fused by reciprocal-rank fusion.
Vector database used for air-gapped hybrid search.
Public PDF RAG benchmark; layout pipeline page hit@5 85.5% vs 95.5% ground-truth text.
DETR model for table structure; row boundary-F1 0.72, column IoU-F1 0.94.
MCP server exposing document search and graph walks as tools for AI assistants.
Open protocol letting AI assistants call external tools.
Per-key, per-task token and cost budgets for OpenAI keys with atomic reservations.
Planned citation-verifying research agent over the MCP tools.
Async FastAPI + Celery + Redis platform running 7 NLP models, ~8,400 emails/hour/node.
In-memory data store used as broker and result store.
25+ parallel input, retrieval and output scanners: injection, PII, toxicity, hallucination.
Llama-3 teacher-to-student for text-to-SQL; 4-bit student 54.6% vs teacher 83.3%.
Model compression with QLoRA, AWQ and GPTQ.
143-function feature library and PySpark GBT models for 5 loan products.
Distributed data processing and MLlib models.
